title: Mini Blinds
text: Mini Blinds. For the price I paid for these I got a good deal. Unfortunately the little clips to hold them at the bottom broke within the first few days. But other than that these are nice inexpensive blinds.

product_metadata.title: Achim Home Furnishings Corded Morningstar 1" Light Filtering Mini Blind, Width 35inch, Length 64inch Drop
features: Includes a 2 Slat Valance and Tilt Wand to Control Light and Privacy
All Brackets and Screws Need for Installtion are Included
description: These blinds will fit 1/2" wider and 3/8" smaller than stated size. The head rail will measure 1/2" less than stated size. Lead free PVC Vinyl construction Choose your size and color from the drop down menus Includes a slat type valance All brackets are included These blinds can be shortened, the instructions to do so are enclosed EZ Cleaning.
